name: Tinted icons
description: Two switches under Theme > Tint Icons, each usable on its own. True Matugen Icons rethemes app icons in the tray, dock, workspaces and launcher through a lightness ramp of the theme's primary family, so every icon lands in one hue with its shading intact (method ported from Iconicul by dvrkxed). True Monochrome flattens them to a single colour. The stock Tint Icons blend is untouched; the active workspace and selected launcher entry swap to the primary colour.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Adds the theme.trueMatugenIcons and theme.trueMonochromeTint keys to theme.json
Changes how app icons are rendered in the bar, dock and launcher while the switches are on
